1.consolidated_definition: Planta enredadera de hojas perennes, flores de color castaño rojizo con estrías púrpura, fruto en forma de cápsula y semillas planas; tiene propiedades medicinales. Aristolochiaceae Aristolochia parviflora.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial climbing plant with perennial leaves, reddish-brown flowers with purple striations, capsule-shaped fruit and flat seeds; it has medicinal properties. Family Aristolochiaceae, species Aristolochia parviflora.
